name: CSOD
note: The anonymous visitor token comes from the career page itself and is sent only to the platform's own API; no login.

name: Dayforce
note: Reads the anonymous CSRF token the site issues to every visitor; no challenge is served. Descriptions from the list are cut short on long postings.

name: Dover
note: the job data endpoints are disallowed by robots.txt; only job URLs are allowed

name: Freshteam
note: Some boards' schema.org data may swap region and city.

name: GoHire
note: Board ids are case-sensitive.

name: JazzHR
note: A feed over the 10 MB response cap (Crunch Fitness, 843 jobs) cannot be read; boards are listed in app.jazz.co's public sitemaps

name: Paycom
note: robots.txt disallows the search endpoint that lists jobs (only single known postings are allowed) and there is no sitemap, so jobs cannot be enumerated without ignoring it.

name: Paycor
note: robots.txt on recruitingbypaycor.com disallows everything

name: Rival
note: robots.txt asks for a 10-second crawl delay, so a full crawl is slow

name: SmartRecruiters
note: robots.txt turns away every crawler except LinkedIn's

name: talentReef
note: Reads the public search host that talentReef's own career page calls for every visitor (its name says internal, but it is the production address, answers anonymous requests and has no robots.txt rules).

name: TriNet
note: Robots.txt signals ai-train=no: ERIO indexes these jobs for search only and never trains a model on them.

name: UltiPro
note: robots.txt disallows the search API, so only the featured jobs on each board page (2 to 20) are read.

name: Pandapé
note: Reads the career site's job list and each job page's schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt asks only that /Apply/ is left alone.

name: Factorial
note: Reads the tenant sitemap and each job page's schema.org JobPosting. Only Factorial's own career site was found live; other customers' career pages were not located.

name: TRAFFIT
note: Reads the public JSON list every TRAFFIT career site serves; the employer is not named in it, so the board's company is used.

name: Emply
note: Reads the career site's own vacancy search call; the page names the list to read. Open-application (talent pool) entries are skipped. The sitemap lists no jobs.

name: HiringRoom
note: No feed or structured data: reads the server-rendered job list and job pages. The page gives no posting date.

name: coveto
note: Reads the tenant sitemap and each job page's schema.org JobPosting; customers on their own domain are added by sitemap address.

name: JobKit
note: Only one populated board exists (jobs.rubyonrails.org); about 20 other JobKit boards are empty.

name: JobBoardFire
note: Cloudflare answers some job pages with HTTP 429, so a fast crawl can read part of a board.

name: Talenetic
note: hosted boards disallow everything in robots.txt and require sign-in

name: CareerSiteCloud
note: Only wpp.careersitecloud.com allows crawlers; every other tenant checked disallows everything or refuses requests.

name: JobBoard.com
note: Only one live board found: the vendor lists no customers, and every showcase site is dead or off the platform.

name: Artha
note: Job pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) and the lists render client-side; reading them would mean working around bot protection.

name: eJobBoard
note: No live job board running the software could be found: the vendor's sites are dead or parked, so there is nothing to read.

name: ejobsitesoftware.com
note: connectagri.com was dropped as an example: its jobs link to a private address, which ERIO rejects.

name: Arbeitnow
note: Free public API, no access key. Credit: link back to Arbeitnow.com (its terms, section 11); every job links to its Arbeitnow page.

name: Remote OK
note: Public JSON feed, no access key. Credit: a followed link back to the job on Remote OK and a mention of Remote OK as the source (its API terms); the Remote OK logo is not used.

name: We Work Remotely
note: Public RSS feed. Credit: attribute the links back to We Work Remotely (its feed page); every job links to its We Work Remotely page.

name: Jobicy
note: Public Jobs API, no access key; lists the last 7 days. Credit: Jobicy is named as the original source and the job links to its Jobicy listing (its fair-use rules).

name: Working Nomads
note: The public JSON feed its site links as API, no access key; it states no attribution rule, so Working Nomads is credited anyway and every job links to its Working Nomads page. Its terms say nothing about reading the feed; worth a written yes before launch.

name: Python.org Jobs
note: The Python Job Board's public RSS feed (20 newest jobs, no posted date). Credit: Python Job Board (Python Software Foundation) and a link to the job on python.org. It publishes no reuse terms for the feed beyond offering it for subscription; worth a written yes before launch.

name: Arbetsformedlingen (Sweden)
note: The Swedish Public Employment Service's JobSearch API: no access key, ads licensed CC0. Credit given anyway: Arbetsformedlingen / JobTech. The API pages at most 2,100 ads, so a crawl reads the newest ones and is reported as partial.

name: EURES (European Job Mobility Portal)
note: The portal's public vacancy search, no access key. Credit: re-use is authorised when the European Labour Authority (EURES) is acknowledged as the source; the EURES logo is not used. Its robots.txt asks for 10 seconds between requests, so a crawl reads the newest 250 jobs and is reported as partial.

name: Werken voor Nederland
note: Dutch central government vacancies, read from each vacancy page's structured data and text. Its copyright page puts the content under CC0 (no credit required); photos excluded, and the Rijksoverheid must not appear to endorse a derived work. A crawl reads the first 200 vacancies of its sitemap and is reported as partial.

name: Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit (Germany)
note: The Jobsuche API answers 403 without an access key header; the key is one constant value printed in its documentation, which counts as a credential, so it is not used. Ask the agency for terms that allow reading without one.

name: NAV (Norway)
note: The Arbeidsplassen job feed answers 401 without a bearer token that has to be requested from NAV, so it needs a credential and is not built. Norwegian vacancies are partly covered through EURES.

name: Himalayas
note: Its API needs no key, but its API terms allow showing jobs only on sites you operate and forbid passing them on to other job boards, aggregators or job search engines, including through feeds; ERIO's public API and assistant tools would pass them on. Needs a decision, or a written permission from the service.

name: MyCareersFuture (Singapore)
note: Its terms of use reserve all rights in the site content and forbid reproducing, publicly displaying or otherwise using it except as the terms or the employer allow; nothing allows listing the jobs elsewhere. Ask the Singapore Workforce Development Agency for permission.

name: Cryptocurrency Jobs
note: Its terms reserve all rights in the content and forbid commercial use without a licence; the feed it serves carries only a one-line excerpt anyway.

name: Remotive
note: Its robots.txt disallows /api/ and the job pages, where its public API and feeds live, so there is no path ERIO may read.

name: Gemeentebanen (Netherlands)
note: Its only published terms are supplier terms for the municipalities that buy its career sites; nothing lets third parties read and show the listings, and no feed is offered. Ask Jobsrepublic.nl for permission.

name: Instaffo
note: Jobs from Instaffo (jobs.instaffo.com); each links back to its Instaffo page. Reads the English job pages' schema.org JobPosting from the jobs sitemap; its robots.txt allows them.

name: Jobberman
note: Jobs from Jobberman (Nigeria); each links back to its Jobberman listing. Reads the listings sitemaps its robots.txt names and each listing's schema.org JobPosting.

name: BrighterMonday
note: Jobs from BrighterMonday (Kenya, Uganda), the same platform as Jobberman; each links back to its listing. Reads the listings sitemaps its robots.txt names and each listing's schema.org JobPosting.

name: Torre
note: Jobs from Torre (torre.ai); each links back to its Torre post. Reads the sitemap and each /post/ page's schema.org JobPosting; the /api/ paths robots.txt disallows are not used.

name: MyJobMag Africa
note: Jobs from MyJobMag (Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa); each links back to MyJobMag. Reads the aggregate feed the site publishes for job aggregators.

name: Jobnet (Denmark)
note: Jobnet (the Danish state job portal) serves no robots.txt or sitemap to crawlers (they redirect to an error page), publishes no feed or documented API, and its job search runs on a back end made for its own app; ask the Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment (STAR) for access.

name: Apploi
note: Reads the server-rendered company page on apply-jobs.apploi.com (robots.txt allows it) and the schema.org JobPosting on each job page; 15 jobs a page, up to 10 pages. The jobs.apploi.com app is not read: its job search calls an API with an Authorization bearer header.

name: Sólides
note: Reads the portal's own public list, vagas.solides.com.br/api/vacancies (robots.txt allows all), the newest 500 jobs a crawl out of tens of thousands, so it is reported as a partial read. Jobs link to vagas.solides.com.br.

name: InHire
note: Reads the public career-page API documented at docs.inhire.com.br (GET api.inhire.app/job-posts/public/pages with the X-Tenant header, the start of the tenant's {tenant}.inhire.app address). The list has no descriptions.

name: Recrutei
note: Reads Recrutei Empregos, the job board of Recrutei customers: the sitemap of job pages and the schema.org JobPosting on each (robots.txt allows both). 200 pages a crawl, so large boards are partial. Companies' own jobs.recrutei.com.br pages list jobs through a POST API and are not read.

name: Senior Portal de Talentos
note: Reads the anonymous searchVacancies query the portal's own pages call (no sign-in, no robots.txt on the host): every employer's jobs, 100 a page, up to 10 pages a crawl (partial). The list has no descriptions. Jobs link to {tenant}.portaldetalentos.senior.com.br.

name: eArcu
note: robots.txt disallows */action/* and */ajaxaction/*, which the career sites' job search and paging use (only the first result page renders without them), and there is no sitemap or feed.

name: eRecruiter
note: no public way to list a customer's jobs was found: eRecruiter's own board (jobs.erecruiter.net) shows no open jobs and no JSON-LD, there is no shared host, sitemap or feed, and customers' career sites run on their own domains.

name: Intervieweb / Inrecruiting
note: Reads the first page (15 jobs) of a company's /{company}/it/career page and the schema.org JobPosting on each job page; a board with more pages is a partial read, because later pages need a script-issued CSRF POST. Some companies' job pages carry no JobPosting data (colombinispa, colorobbia) and fail. App.php?LAC= addresses are not used (robots.txt disallows them).

name: The Hub
note: Reads thehub.io's sitemap of job pages and the schema.org JobPosting on each (robots.txt allows both); 200 pages a crawl, of about 1,200 Nordic start-up jobs (partial).

name: AppliTrack / Frontline
note: Reads the embeddable posting list districts put on their own sites, www.applitrack.com/{district}/onlineapp/JobPostings/view.asp?embed=1&all=1 (robots.txt only closes the admin area). Descriptions are the posting text; some say only to open the attachment.

name: CHECK-IN by perbility
note: Reads a portal's /list (10 a page, up to 5 pages, partial beyond) and the schema.org microdata on each job page at {portal}.mein-check-in.de (robots.txt allows it). Portals on www.mein-check-in.de/{customer}/ and jobs.perbility.de are other products and are not read.

name: Cegid DigitalRecruiters
note: Career sites sit on the employer's own domain; the board is the site's sitemap and each /annonce/ page carries a schema.org JobPosting. These sites ask for a 10 second delay between requests, so reading 200 job pages takes over half an hour (partial).

name: Jibe
note: Reads the JSON the career site's own job search calls (/api/jobs), on the employer's own domain; no login. Sites ask for a crawl delay of 5 seconds, which the fetcher honours.

name: JobScore
note: Reads the company's public XML job feed on careers.jobscore.com; its robots.txt only disallows the apply flow.

name: softgarden
note: Reads the schema.org job feed (jobs.feed.json) that each career page publishes for machines.

name: Get on Board
note: Public API v0 of Get on Board (Latin America tech jobs), read per category. Its robots.txt allows search indexing and reserves AI training, so ERIO only indexes and links back; credit Get on Board and send candidates to the job's page there.

name: SOLID.Jobs
note: Polish IT job board, read from each offer page's structured data via its sitemap (newest offers first); its robots.txt allows crawling outside /management/ and /admin/. A crawl reads at most 200 offers and is reported as partial. Credit SOLID.Jobs and link back.

name: Betterteam
note: Every request, even to its sitemap.xml, /jobs and /api/jobs, answers 403 with a 'Quick security check' bot-challenge page, so nothing can be read without passing it.

name: Workstream
note: Its documented API needs a bearer token; its public job pages (www.workstream.us/j/{id}/{company}) carry no feed or structured data, and the only company page found had no open jobs, so no way to read jobs was verified.

name: beesite
note: Career sites are built per customer on their own domains (the vendor says the career site is made together with the provider); no shared host, public feed or documented API was found, and none of the customer sites checked had structured job data.

name: Helix by perbility
note: perbility publishes only marketing pages (mein-helix.de); customer career sites are built per customer on their own domains and no public job feed or documented API was found.

name: Compleo
note: No vendor site, career-page host, feed or API for a platform of this name could be found (compleo.de refuses connections; compleet.com is a different company), so there is nothing to read.

name: inploi
note: Career sites are built per employer; inploi's own (careers.inploi.com) lists no jobs and has an empty sitemap, and no employer site with jobs, feed or API was found.

name: CATS
note: Career portals on {account}.catsone.com are rendered on the server and read page by page; CATS's own API needs a key and is not used. Token is account/portalId.

name: HRM Direct / ClearCompany
note: Old {tenant}.hrmdirect.com addresses redirect to apply.clearcompany.com/{tenant}; jobs come from the public job widget's feed, which the career page names by its site id.

name: concludis
note: Reads the job list of a *.concludis.de career page and the JobPosting data on each job page. Boards that redirect to a customer's own domain are not read; only one live list board was found, so a second is still needed.

name: Feishu Hire
note: Reads the anonymous CSRF token the site issues to every visitor, then the search the career site itself calls; no login. Token is tenant/path. A big board (ByteDance, Li Auto) is read in part and reported incomplete.

name: HERP
note: Reads the schema.org JobPosting data on each job page linked from a herp.careers/v1/{company} list.

name: PyjamaHR
note: Reads the career-page API of jobs.pyjamahr.com; PyjamaHR's account API needs a token and is not used. Token is company slug/company uuid from the career page's data.

name: Recruitify
note: The portal's API picks the company by the portal address (Origin header). Only Recruitify's own portal was found, and its single job is a sample, so a second live board is still needed.

name: rexx systems
note: Reads schema.org JobPosting data on each job page of a {customer}-portal.rexx-systems.com career portal.

name: Velora HR
note: Reads the anonymous career-site API (api.velorahr.com/api/public/career-site/{id}/offers). Token is subdomain/id from the career-site address.

name: Jobylon
note: Public job pages of emp.jobylon.com from its sitemap (schema.org JobPosting); robots.txt allows crawlers. Credit: link each job back to its Jobylon page.

name: SchoolSpring
note: The anonymous API behind schoolspring.com (api.schoolspring.com); the token is an employer name used as the site's own search keyword. Credit: link each job back to its SchoolSpring page.

name: Airswift Jobs
note: The staffing firm's own job pages (schema.org JobPosting), listed on airswift.com/jobs; robots.txt allows them. Credit: link each job back to its Airswift page.

name: CVWarehouse
note: no public job list: candidate.cvwarehouse.com has no job index or sitemap (jobs open only by numeric id), the job search sits behind its login page, and the customer job feed is given to each customer rather than published.

name: Nicoka CABS
note: no shared public job surface: tenant hosts ({name}.nicoka.com) serve the login app (robots.txt answers 403), and customers publish jobs on their own bespoke sites (for example externatic.fr), so there is nothing platform-wide to read.

name: greytHR Hire
note: Reads the JSON calls the career page {tenant}.greythr.com/hire/jobs makes (published_jobs, company details, place lookup); no login. Token is the tenant subdomain.

name: Orion Group Jobs
note: the job list is loaded by script from gateway.wearevennture.co.uk, which answers 401 to a plain request (it needs the site browser session); the sitemap lists no job pages and job URLs redirect to the search app.

name: Hireful
note: not verifiable: the career app on {tenant}.livevacancies.co.uk reads api.core-easywebats.com/v1/job/all with a per-tenant company id, but the only tenant found (hireful.livevacancies.co.uk) lists 0 jobs and no second public tenant could be found.

name: Eploy
note: not verifiable: careers sites run on each customer own domain (careers.{name}/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx) with no shared host, and the only tenant found (careers.eploy.co.uk) publishes an empty live-jobs.xml sitemap and no job links.

name: Jobcan Recruitment
note: not verifiable: ats.jobcan.jp is the sign-in app (redirects to id.jobcan.jp login) and the vendor documents no public career-page host; no public tenant job page could be found to read.

name: d.vinci
note: Reads each career site sitemap and the schema.org JobPosting on every /{lang}/jobs/{id}/ page. Sites differ in robots.txt: some (impulse.dvinci-hr.com) disallow everything but widget paths and must not be registered. Token is the sitemap URL.

name: Bizneo
note: not verifiable: no public tenant career site could be found; the only Bizneo-hosted one located (hello.bizneo.com/out-career-site/) answers "Career site - out of service", and customers embed the portal on their own domains.

name: Friend.work
note: Reads the JSON the career portal jobs.friend.work/{portal} loads from api.friend.work (company and all published vacancies in one call). Token is the portal name; salaries are per month. Portals found hold old or demo vacancies.

name: HR-Manager (Talentech)
note: candidate.hr-manager.net/robots.txt disallows everything except single ApplicationInit.aspx application forms, so its vacancy lists cannot be read; no public feed or sitemap was found.

name: Visma EasyCruit
note: every {tenant}.easycruit.com request (ntnu, visma, easycruit tested) is answered by an AWS WAF bot challenge (HTTP 202, empty body, x-amzn-waf-action: challenge), which must not be bypassed.

name: GetHired / EasyApply
note: not verifiable: {tenant}.easyapply.co career pages serve an /rss feed that robots.txt allows, but every tenant found (gethired, jobs, acme, hiring, restaurant, dental and others) returned an empty feed, so no job item could be read; no customer tenant with openings could be found.

name: LiveHire / Humanforce Talent
note: Reads each tenant career sitemap (listed in www.livehire.com/SitemapCareers.xml) and the schema.org JobPosting on every /careers/{tenant}/job/ page; the talent-search API needs a session bearer and is not used. Token is the tenant sitemap URL.

name: Teamdash
note: no shared public job surface: {tenant}.teamdash.com (tallink, lhv tested) and jobs.teamdash.com serve the recruiter sign-in app with no job list, and customers publish career sites on their own domains with no common feed or sitemap.

name: skeeled
note: the hosted career page app.skeeled.com/careers/{id} is a script app whose data runs over a websocket service (wss://app.skeeled.com/ws); no HTTP job list, feed, sitemap or structured data was found, and customers embed it by iframe on their own sites.

name: TalentHR
note: every {company}.talenthr.io path (careers, jobs, job-openings) returns the same login app shell (canonical /login, a 1 KB script page), jobs.talenthr.io is an empty static page, and no public job list, feed, sitemap or structured data was found.

name: ApplicantPool
note: A brand of the ApplicantPro platform: reads the public JSON job list {sub}.applicantpool.com/core/jobs/{domainId} and each job page schema.org JobPosting. Tenants are listed in feeds.applicantpool.com/site_map_index.xml. Token is subdomain/domainId.

name: AcademicTransfer
note: Public vacancy pages of academictransfer.com (Dutch and international academic jobs) read from its vacancies sitemap (schema.org JobPosting); robots.txt allows crawlers with a 10 second delay, so a crawl reads the newest 100. Credit: link each job back to its AcademicTransfer page.

name: HRMOS
note: Public career pages of hrmos.co/pages/{company}/jobs (server-rendered list, 100 per page) and each job page's schema.org JobPosting; hrmos.co has no robots.txt. Token is the company's jobs page address.

name: onlyfy
note: no public job list: {company}.onlyfy.jobs serves a client-rendered, noindex candidate portal (no job links, sitemap or feed in the page; /jobs, /sitemap.xml and feeds answer 404), and job data loads through the app's private GraphQL endpoint

name: TechTree
note: no identifiable public job source: techtree.dk, techtree.com, techtree.io, techtree.ai and techtree.in are unrelated sites (a biotech firm, an education site, an event page, a web agency) with no job feed, sitemap or job pages, and web search finds no TechTree job board or career platform

name: Loxo
note: Public careers pages of Loxo agencies: app.loxo.co/{agency} lists the published jobs (server-rendered) and each job page on {agency}.app.loxo.co carries the description as JSON; robots.txt allows all. The token is the agency name.

name: Gestmax / Kioskemploi
note: Public career sites of Gestmax (Kioskemploi) customers at {name}.gestmax.fr: the server-rendered /search list (10 per page) and each job page's fields and text; no robots.txt is served. The token is the site name or its https address.

name: Djinni
note: Djinni's public job list (djinni.co/jobs/?page=n, 15 jobs per page): every job carries schema.org JobPosting data with the description inline; robots.txt allows /jobs/ and the sitemap. A crawl reads the newest 20 pages. Credit: link each job back to its Djinni page.

name: Hurma
note: no public job list found: {company}.hurma.work answers with the tenant login page, the help center does not name the career site address, and no customer career page could be found by search

name: Taleez
note: Public job pages of taleez.com (French recruiting platform) read from sitemap-job.xml (/apply/{id}, schema.org JobPosting); robots.txt allows /apply/ for crawlers. A crawl reads the newest 100 of the sitemap. Credit: link each job back to its Taleez page.

name: speedrun talent network
note: The a16z speedrun portfolio job board: its jobs.rss feed lists the 100 newest roles and each role page carries a schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt allows crawlers except decoy pages. Credit: link each job back to its speedrun talent network page.

name: Simplify.hr
note: Public job list of jobs.simplify.hr (the Simplify.hr employers' open vacancies, ten a page) and each vacancy page's schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt allows crawlers other than AI-training bots. A crawl reads the first 100. Credit: link each job back to its Simplify.hr page.

name: SeamlessHiring
note: no public job list: {company}.seamlesshiring.com serves a client-rendered single page app (no job links or structured data in the HTML; /sitemap.xml, /jobs and feeds answer 404), and jobs load through an undocumented private API

name: Quickin
note: Quickin's documented public career page API (api.quickin.io/public/{account}/jobs, JSON, no authentication); the token is the account id that the career page jobs.quickin.io/{name} embeds in its page data.

name: Jobtrain
note: Public Jobtrain career sites at www.jobtrain.co.uk/{client}: the site's own job card list (/{client}/Home/_JobCard) names each vacancy and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting; jobtrain.co.uk serves no robots.txt. The token is the client name.

name: Gupy
note: Public Gupy career pages at {company}.gupy.io: the page's own data lists the open jobs and each /jobs/{id} page's data adds the description; robots.txt allows all. Talent-pool entries are skipped. The token is the subdomain.

name: HireClick
note: HireClick's own job board (careers.hireclick.com/jobboard): its list call /api/Controllers/JobBoard/GetSettingsAndJobs names the open jobs and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt allows crawlers with a 10 second delay. The token is the employer id the board page prints (only HireClick's own board could be found; customer boards were not found by search).

name: AppOne / Paychex
note: no public job list: AppOne career sites (joinsyf.appone.com) list jobs only through an ASP.NET form postback with view state (Search.aspx answers 404 to a plain request), and there is no sitemap or feed (www.appone.com/sitemap.xml and /robots.txt answer 404); single job pages (MainInfoReq.asp?R_ID=) cannot be enumerated

name: talentstorm
note: no public job list: career sites ({name}.talentstorm.de) are a client-rendered Angular app with no job links or structured data in the HTML, and its job offers endpoint (api.talentstorm.de/api/v1/joboffers/basic) answers 401 Authentication Required

name: Crelate
note: The RSS feed every Crelate candidate portal publishes (jobs.crelate.com/portal/{org}/rss); robots.txt allows it. Token is the portal name. Portals that are switched off answer with a disabled page.

name: GeekJob
note: Jobs from GeekJob (geekjob.ru, Russian IT jobs); each links back to its GeekJob page. Reads the server-rendered /vacancies/{n} lists and each vacancy's schema.org JobPosting; its robots.txt allows them (it disallows only /json/ and /rest/). Credit: link each job back to GeekJob.

name: Beehire
note: The JSON each Beehire career page (app.beehire.com/career/{name}) loads for visitors (/users/getPublicCampaigns/{name}); robots.txt allows it. Token is the career page name. Apply link is the job's public invitation page; standing spontaneous-application forms are skipped.

name: Keka
note: The JSON that Keka Hire career sites ({tenant}.keka.com/careers) and Keka's embed code load for visitors (/careers/api/jobs/default/active, plus careerportalinfo for the company name); robots.txt allows /careers. Token is the tenant, or tenant/portal for a non-default portal.

name: Connectoor
note: Jobs from Connectoor.jobs, the public job board of the Connectoor recruiting software (Germany); each links back to its Connectoor job page. Reads the board's own embedded search (api.connectoor.de/find, newest first, a capped number per crawl) and each job's schema.org JobPosting on app.connectoor.de; neither host publishes a robots.txt restriction. Credit: link each job back to Connectoor.

name: Talos360 ATS
note: Customer career sites on {tenant}.talosats-careers.com: each serves a sitemap of its job pages and every page carries a schema.org JobPosting; no robots.txt restriction is published. Token is the sitemap address, https://{tenant}.talosats-careers.com/sitemap.xml.

name: Recruitis
note: Career sites on jobs.recruitis.io/{company}: server-rendered lists (paged with jobs_list_form[page]) and one page per job; no feed, API or structured data is public, so the page markup is read. jobs.recruitis.io serves no robots.txt restriction. Token is the company name in the address.

name: ApplicantStack
note: Career pages on {tenant}.applicantstack.com: the server-rendered /x/openings list and one /x/detail/{id} page per job (summary table plus description); robots.txt allows them. ApplicantStack's own API needs a key and is not used. Token is the tenant.

name: OpenCATS
note: Self-hosted OpenCATS installations publish a careers module ({site}/careers/): a server-rendered list (index.php?m=careers&p=showAll) and a page per job; no feed or structured data is public, so the page markup is read. Each installation sits on its owner's own domain, so the token is the address of its careers folder, for example https://vectaur.com/ats/careers/; the generic 'upload a resume for general consideration' entry is skipped.

name: Prevue APS
note: Customer career sites on {tenant}.prevueaps.com: each serves a sitemap of its job pages (/job_site_map.xml; the vendor also lists all tenants in feeds.prevueaps.com/site_map_index.xml) and every job page carries a schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt allows them. Token is the sitemap address, https://{tenant}.prevueaps.com/job_site_map.xml.

name: MCi Direct Hire
note: Jobs from Job Central (jobs.mcidirecthire.com), the public job board of MCi Direct Hire's recruitment software (mostly South African employers); each links back to its Job Central vacancy page. Reads the board's own paged job cards (/AvailableVacancies/JobSearch, newest first, five pages per crawl, so a crawl is partial) with the opening of each description; the host serves no robots.txt restriction. Credit: link each job back to Job Central.

name: Flatchr
note: Career sites on careers.flatchr.io/fr/company/{company}: the Next.js page embeds every published vacancy (description, place, contract) in its page data, so one request reads a company; robots.txt turns away only a few named bots. Flatchr's own API needs a token and is not used. Token is the company name in the address.

name: Jobspage
note: Careers pages on {company}.jobspage.co: each serves a sitemap of its job pages and every job page carries a schema.org JobPosting; robots.txt allows them (only the vendor's own /jobs/ and /account/ paths are disallowed). Token is the sitemap address, https://{company}.jobspage.co/sitemap.xml. Only the vendor's demo and test careers pages could be found, so the examples are demo data, not a real employer; real customer pages are on the same pattern.

name: Talent Clue
note: Customer career sites on {tenant}.talentclue.com: the server-rendered offers table (/es/company/{id}/offers/menu/modal) and one /es/node/{n}/{template} page per job (summary plus description); robots.txt allows them (Crawl-delay 10, honoured by the fetcher, so a large site takes long). No feed, API or structured data is public. Token is tenant/companyId, taken from the career site's own offers-list address; the standing 'send your CV with no open offer' entry is skipped.

name: Mindsight
note: No vendor site, career-site host, feed or API for a recruiting product of this name could be found: mindsight.com is a domain for sale, mindsight.nl and mindsight.ai are parked or redirect to a landing page, and the other organisations called Mindsight are unrelated employers on their own sites.

name: NoDesk
note: Its Terms of Use (nodesk.co/legal/terms) forbid using any means to mirror, frame, scrape, crawl or spider the site or to reach it other than through its own interfaces, even though robots.txt allows crawling (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no); a written permission from NoDesk would be needed.

name: Recrut'Auto
note: recrutauto.fr is a LinkedIn recruiting-automation product with only marketing pages (its sitemap lists 19 pages, none a job), recrutauto.com shows a site-under-construction page, and no public career site, feed or API listing jobs was found.

name: Homerun
note: Reads the Atom feed every Homerun career site advertises in its page head (feed.homerun.co/{tenant}); descriptions inline. Token is the career-site subdomain; the standing open-application entry is skipped.

name: HR Office
note: Reads the career sites HR Office builds on employers' own domains: /sitemap.xml lists /vacatures/{id}-{slug} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Only sites that publish that structured data are read (a bespoke site such as werkenbij.adver-online.nl has none). Token is the sitemap address.

name: RecrutOr
note: Reads a RecrutOr career space (www.recrutor.pro/{tenant}/): the space's RSS feed lists the job pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting (place, employer, type). Token is the tenant name from the address.

name: TalentAdore
note: Reads the position list a TalentAdore customer's career site embeds (ats.talentadore.com/positions/{code}/json, also /rss): title, unit, place, type and description inline. Token is the list code taken from that address; the career site's page names it.

name: Huntflow
note: Reads Huntflow career sites ({tenant}.huntflow.io, {tenant}.global.huntflow.io): the sitemap lists /vacancy/{slug} pages, read from the server-rendered Nuxt payload (title, place, sections). Token is the site name, e.g. prisma or cryptopay.global. Archived vacancies are skipped.

name: Enlizt / Plooral
note: Reads Plooral (Enlizt) career sites at {tenant}.enlizt.me: the server-rendered job list links /vagas/{slug} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the career-site address, e.g. https://dr.enlizt.me/. Sites with no open jobs list none.

name: SelfRecruit
note: no public vendor site or career pages found: selfrecruit.com is a parked domain for sale and no other selfrecruit domain resolves, so no tenant can be located

name: Odoo Recruitment
note: Reads the /jobs pages of Odoo websites: current versions mark each job up as a schema.org JobPosting (JSON-LD, or microdata on www.odoo.com); token is the https address of the site's /jobs list (paged as /jobs/page/n) or its sitemap. Themes and older versions with no structured data (for example jobsodoo.com) are not read.

name: BITE Bewerbermanager
note: Reads the public job portal jobs.b-ite.com that BITE customers publish to: its sitemap lists /jobposting/{id} pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting naming the employer. robots.txt allows crawlers except the apply form. BITE customers' own career pages are not read. Credit: link each job back to its BITE page.

name: Tecla
note: Reads the public job list the jobs page of app.tecla.io loads without sign-in (api.tecla.io/api/jobs/getPublicJobs/, paged): client company, remote role, USD pay range, short description and benefits. The list carries only a description excerpt. Token is https://api.tecla.io. Credit: link each job back to its Tecla page.

name: HR4YOU
note: Reads HR4YOU career sites ({tenant}.hr4you.org): /sitemap.xml lists /job/view/{id}/... pages, each with a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the sitemap address. Some tenants (for example krh.hr4you.org) answer every request with a bot-check page and are not read; robots.txt allows only the list, view and sitemap paths.

name: HRworks
note: Reads HRworks job portals (jobapplication.hrworks.de/de?companyId={id}, jobs.hrworks.de): the list page links each job as ?id={id} and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the portal's list address, taken from the career page.

name: RecruiterFlow
note: Reads Recruiterflow career pages (recruiterflow.com/{tenant}/jobs): the page embeds the list of its jobs (window.jobsList) and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the career page address.

name: Talentio
note: Reads Talentio (Japan) career pages: open.talentio.com/r/1/c/{company}/homes/{id} lists its job pages in the data it hands its page script, and each job page carries a schema.org JobPosting. Token is the company home page address. Pages that publish no JobPosting (and companies that only redirect elsewhere) list nothing.

name: Jobsoid
note: Reads the JSON job list every Jobsoid career portal loads ({tenant}.jobsoid.com/api/v1/jobs): title, place, type, date and description inline; apply links use the portal's own or custom domain. Token is the portal subdomain. An unknown subdomain answers an empty list.

name: Occupop / Cezanne Recruitment
note: career sites (*.occupop-careers.com) are client-rendered apps that load jobs through a GraphQL gateway keyed by tenant, with no server-rendered jobs, feed or sitemap; the only static surface (api.occupop.com/api/jobs-frame/{embed id}) needs a per-employer embed id that only the employer's own site reveals, and only one such id was found, so no board can be discovered or two verified

name: Jobtoolz
note: Each {tenant}.jobtoolz.com serves /sitemap.xml with /{language}/{job} pages carrying a schema.org JobPosting. robots.txt bars only URLs with a query string (Disallow: /*?), which the fetcher now reads correctly. A job offered in several languages is listed once per language.

name: Workopolis
note: Cloudflare bot challenge: even /robots.txt answers 403 'Just a moment...' (Cf-Mitigated: challenge), so ERIO cannot read the site's crawl rules, and ERIO never solves a challenge (D-19)
